vectors.description: Appends a complete event with stable identity, entity, actor, and explicit timestamp.
Allows actor omission when the responsible actor is unknown without inventing an Actor identity.
Rejects a supplied actor without its stable identifier and preserves committed history.
Rejects an empty supplied actor identifier and preserves committed history.
Rejects a supplied actor that is not a JSON object and preserves committed history.
Rejects a supplied actor whose optional type is not a non-empty string.
Selects invalid event before invalid actor when both candidate representations are malformed.
Selects invalid actor before duplicate identity for a structurally valid candidate.
Selects duplicate identity before a history-dependent relationship inconsistency.
Selects invalid event for malformed supplied history before validating a malformed candidate actor.
Preserves actor identifiers as opaque values without case normalization or interpretation.
Preserves display metadata as context without replacing stable actor identity.
Preserves actor identity recorded on an existing committed event when later history is appended.
Rejects event metadata that attempts to restate required Audit Event fields.
Rejects an implementation-mechanism event type instead of treating it as a domain event identifier.
Rejects a missing occurrence timestamp without partially appending.
Rejects an entity reference without stable identity.
Rejects an already committed event identity without duplication.
Forbids replacing a committed event.
Forbids removing a committed event.
Preserves the direction of a recorded prior-to-resulting change.
Keeps an absent prior value distinct from an explicit null resulting value.
Preserves stable Money value representations recorded in before and after change values.
Rejects a Change that claims a field changed when before and after values are equal.
Redacts optional actor context while preserving actor identity and actor type.
Redacts protected values while preserving event meaning, leaving the committed source event unchanged, and adding redaction evidence.
Rejects a redaction policy that identifies no protected content in the supplied history without mutating history.
Rejects an explicitly supplied empty actor display name and preserves empty history.
Rejects an explicitly supplied numeric actor display name and preserves empty history.
Rejects an explicitly supplied null actor display name and preserves empty history.
Rejects an explicitly supplied null actor type and preserves empty history.
Rejects malformed actor attribution in supplied history before considering the valid candidate.
Selects invalid actor attribution before duplicate event identity and preserves committed history.
Preserves an explicitly supplied null actor metadata member as distinct from omission.
Redacts explicitly supplied null actor metadata while preserving attribution, source history, and redaction evidence.
Rejects actor metadata redaction when metadata was omitted and preserves source history without evidence append.
Records Boolean true to numeric one as an actual ordinary JSON value change.
Records numeric zero to Boolean false as an actual ordinary JSON value change.
Records recursively nested Boolean and numeric differences as an actual ordinary JSON change.
Rejects an ordinary JSON Change that claims equal Boolean values changed.
Rejects structurally equal ordinary JSON objects as unchanged despite different member order.
Rejects recursively equal ordered arrays as an unchanged ordinary JSON value.
Records arrays with the same members in a different order as an actual ordinary JSON change.
Keeps undeclared Money-shaped objects under ordinary JSON equality instead of inferring Money semantics.
Rejects an explicitly declared Money Change whose exact amount differs only by insignificant trailing zeros.
Records an explicitly declared Money amount change and preserves its domain type declaration.
Records an explicitly declared Money currency change without mapping it to a comparison-operation currency mismatch.
Rejects a malformed explicitly declared Money value using the Audit invalid-event mapping without partial append.
